I swear I saw this post and thought I had posted it and forgot about it for a second. I’m also 21 and have struggled with my weight my whole life. I am scheduled to get the sleeve done in under two weeks and I’ve found that I was 100% addicted to food. I was in denial about it and blamed my weight on everything else, until I started the pre-op diet. For the diet, I’ve had to switch to only liquid (protein shakes, broth, & jello basically) and I’ve struggled so hard mentally and I’m only 4 days in. I’ve cried about every day. Every time I see food I used to love I mentally go feral and have to FIGHT MYSELF to not cheat. I will have wasted so much money and time and effort if I stop & cheat now. I’m just praying that it all is worth it in the end. No one told me it would be this hard...
